name: desktop-configurations
prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: a wide feature illustration for the GitHub README of Halcyon, an existing native COSMIC Linux desktop customization app. This will be captioned as an illustration, not a screenshot.
Input 1 is a reference for the real app's digital clock, circular music widget, native flat surfaces and spectrum. Input 2 is a reference for its warm Paper analog clock/weather cards and layout; ignore the surrounding Settings editor.
Create one carefully composed landscape illustration, roughly 2:1, showing three distinct desktop configurations in three equal side-by-side rectangular panels. Flat head-on desktop views; no computer hardware or floating perspective windows.
First panel: misty dark pine forest and jade lake wallpaper, clean white digital clock, small restrained dark teal weather and system-reading cards, separated small native panel islands.
Second panel: warm pale sandstone landscape and soft morning sun, cream Paper analog clock and weather card, warm dark typography; quiet light-theme desktop.
Third panel: indigo volcanic coast at dusk, charcoal circular music widget with slender lavender radial bars and a low audio spectrum behind a simple dock.
Retain the native widget language from the references: flat or lightly translucent rounded surfaces, readable unembellished UI typography, simple controls. Keep wallpaper visible and the placement composed. Few widgets, not a dashboard crammed with data.
The three environments should be richly detailed original landscape art with distinct light and textures, not repeated recolorings. UI overlays are modest and plausible, not futuristic.
Only minimal sample widget text: "09:41", "21°", "Golden Hour", "Aura". No headlines, labels outside widgets, brand slogans, logos, badges or marketing copy. No fake windows, no controls or capabilities beyond those described. No macOS hardware or interface. No glow, shiny glass, 3D floating cards, artificial bokeh, or gratuitous gradients.

A large thin off-white frameless digital clock at upper-left reads exactly "19:41", with a small simple date line "Friday, October 30". Along the bottom, a compact centered charcoal floating dock with five generic file/browser/terminal/document/settings icons. A low, restrained lavender audio spectrum sits at the bottom edge, behind the dock, short uneven bars; never tall enough to dominate the landscape. No top-level Halcyon title or marketing text inside the image; GitHub headings will supply them.
